judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the test-planning phase and never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to implement usage accumulation. Because the production code is completely unchanged, the newly added acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when `npm test` is run. Additionally, the candidate missed the required `CHANGELOG.md` update, did not update the `afterModelResponse` signature parameter name (`usage` to `totalUsage`), and left a `.lore/dod.md` planning artifact in the diff. On the positive side, the candidate did update `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and wrote well-structured tests covering the multi-round summation and partial `undefined` usage cases, though they placed the tests in a new file instead of `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` where the reference placed them.
